spec.query:
import "timezone"

// Set the global location context
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur")

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "outdoor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "radiation")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${chartInterval}, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["source", "category", "parentId", "_start", "_stop"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

power = from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "power")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "main")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "totalPower")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["category"] == "chiller")
  |> mean()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "power"}))

load = from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "flow")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["category"] == "chiller")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "chwHeader")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "energyFlowRate")
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "coolingLoad", _value: r._value * 78.986}))
  |> group()

union(tables: [power, load])
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["coolingLoad", "power"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with efficiency: if r.coolingLoad > 0.0 then r.power / r.coolingLoad else 0.0 }))

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "flow")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["category"] == "chiller")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "chwHeader")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "chws" or r["_field"] == "chwr" or r["_field"] == "deltaT")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_value"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
